# Wallet Transaction Logic - Comprehensive Audit Report
Generated: 2026-01-23

## Executive Summary

This codebase implements an **escrow-based betting system** with the following money flow characteristics:
- **Escrow on propose**: Proposer's stake is debited immediately when creating a bet
- **Escrow on accept**: Acceptor's stake is debited when accepting
- **Payout on settlement**: Winner receives the entire pool; loser gets nothing (already debited)
- **Refunds on push/void**: Both parties refunded their original stakes

**Overall Assessment**: The transaction logic is **well-designed** with proper locking mechanisms, but has several areas requiring attention for production readiness.

---

## Money Flow Architecture

### 1. Entry Points - How Money Enters the System

**Location:** `/src/main/java/com/ryanmeroniuk/friends_bet/controller/WalletController.java`
**Endpoint:** `POST /api/groups/{groupId}/wallets/deposit`

```java
@PostMapping("/deposit")
public ResponseEntity<WalletResponse> deposit(
    @PathVariable UUID groupId,
    @RequestBody WalletDepositRequest req
) {
    WalletResponse resp = walletService.deposit(groupId, req);
    return ResponseEntity.ok(resp);
}
```

**Flow:**
1. User calls deposit endpoint with `userId` and `amountCents`
2. `WalletService.deposit()` uses pessimistic locking to prevent race conditions
3. Balance is updated: `newBalance = currentBalance + amountCents`
4. Negative balance check: `if (newBalance < 0) throw IllegalArgumentException("Insufficient funds")`

**Note:** The deposit endpoint can accept **negative amounts** for withdrawals (if `amountCents < 0`).

### 2. Debits - When Placing Bets

#### 2a. Proposer Debit (Bet Creation)

**Location:** `/src/main/java/com/ryanmeroniuk/friends_bet/service/BetService.java:102-105`

```java
@Transactional
public BetResponse propose(CreateBetRequest req) {
    // ... validation ...
    
    // Debit proposer stake
    walletService.deposit(
        req.getGroupId(),
        new WalletDepositRequest(req.getProposerId(), -req.getAmountCents())
    );
    
    // Persist bet
    Bet saved = betRepo.save(b);
    return BetMapper.toResponse(saved);
}
```

**Atomicity:** ✓ VERIFIED - Wrapped in `@Transactional`, so wallet debit and bet creation are atomic.

#### 2b. Acceptor Debit (Bet Acceptance)

**Location:** `/src/main/java/com/ryanmeroniuk/friends_bet/service/BetService.java:126-166`

```java
@Transactional
public BetResponse accept(UUID betId, AcceptBetRequest req) {
    // Pessimistic lock on bet to prevent double-acceptance
    Bet bet = betRepo.findByIdForUpdate(betId)
        .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Bet not found"));
    
    if (!"OPEN".equals(bet.getStatus())) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot accept bet in status: " + bet.getStatus());
    }
    
    long acceptorStake = calcAcceptorStake(proposerStake, bet.getOdds());
    
    // Debit acceptor
    walletService.deposit(
        bet.getGroupId(),
        new WalletDepositRequest(actor, -acceptorStake)
    );
    
    bet.setAcceptorId(actor);
    bet.setAcceptorStakeCents(acceptorStake);
    bet.setStatus("ACCEPTED");
    
    Bet updated = betRepo.save(bet);
    return BetMapper.toResponse(updated);
}
```

**Atomicity:** ✓ VERIFIED - Wrapped in `@Transactional`, wallet debit and bet status update are atomic.

**Race Condition Protection:** ✓ VERIFIED - Uses `findByIdForUpdate` with `PESSIMISTIC_WRITE` lock to prevent concurrent acceptances.

**Stake Calculation:**
```java
private static long calcAcceptorStake(long proposerStake, double odds) {
    return BigDecimal.valueOf(proposerStake)
        .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(odds).subtract(BigDecimal.ONE))
        .setScale(0, RoundingMode.HALF_UP)
        .longValueExact();
}
```

### 3. Credits - When Winning Bets

**Location:** `/src/main/java/com/ryanmeroniuk/friends_bet/service/SettlementService.java:56-115`

```java
@Transactional
public int settleGame(UUID gameId) {
    Game g = gameRepo.findById(gameId).orElseThrow();
    if (!g.isFinal() || g.getHomeScore() == null || g.getAwayScore() == null) return 0;
    
    // Pessimistic lock on all bets for this game
    List<Bet> allOnGame = betRepo.findByGameIdForUpdate(gameId);
    int settled = 0;
    
    for (Bet b : allOnGame) {
        if (!STATUS_ACCEPTED.equalsIgnoreCase(b.getStatus())) continue;
        
        Outcome outcome = evaluateOutcome(b, g);
        if (outcome == Outcome.NEEDS_DATA) continue;
        
        long poolCents = safeAdd(proposerStake, acceptorStake);
        
        switch (outcome) {
            case PUSH -> {
                // Refund both sides
                walletService.deposit(groupId, new WalletDepositRequest(proposer, proposerStake));
                walletService.deposit(groupId, new WalletDepositRequest(acceptor, acceptorStake));
                b.setStatus(STATUS_VOID);
            }
            case PROPOSER_WIN -> {
                walletService.deposit(groupId, new WalletDepositRequest(proposer, poolCents));
                b.setStatus(STATUS_RESOLVED);
            }
            case ACCEPTOR_WIN -> {
                walletService.deposit(groupId, new WalletDepositRequest(acceptor, poolCents));
                b.setStatus(STATUS_RESOLVED);
            }
        }
        
        finalizeAndSave(b);
        settled++;
    }
    
    return settled;
}
```

**Atomicity:** ✓ VERIFIED - All settlement logic wrapped in `@Transactional`.

**Race Condition Protection:** ✓ VERIFIED - Uses `findByGameIdForUpdate` with `PESSIMISTIC_WRITE` lock.

**Idempotency:** ✓ VERIFIED - Only settles bets in `ACCEPTED` status, so re-running won't double-pay.

## Database Schema

### Wallet Entity

**Location:** `/src/main/java/com/ryanmeroniuk/friends_bet/model/Wallet.java`

```java
@Entity
@Table(name = "wallets",
    uniqueConstraints = @UniqueConstraint(columnNames = {"group_id", "user_id"}))
public class Wallet {
    
    @Id @GeneratedValue
    private UUID id;
    
    @ManyToOne(optional = false)
    @JoinColumn(name = "group_id", nullable = false)
    private Group group;
    
    @ManyToOne(optional = false)
    @JoinColumn(name = "user_id", nullable = false)
    private User user;
    
    @Column(nullable = false)
    private long balanceCents = 0;
}
```

**Key Constraints:**
- Unique constraint on `(group_id, user_id)` - one wallet per user per group
- `balanceCents` stored as `long` (cents) to avoid floating-point rounding errors ✓

### Wallet Repository with Locking

**Location:** `/src/main/java/com/ryanmeroniuk/friends_bet/repository/WalletRepository.java`

```java
public interface WalletRepository extends JpaRepository<Wallet, UUID> {
    Optional<Wallet> findByGroupAndUser(Group group, User user);
    
    @Lock(LockModeType.PESSIMISTIC_WRITE)
    @Query("SELECT w FROM Wallet w WHERE w.group = :group AND w.user = :user")
    Optional<Wallet> findByGroupAndUserForUpdate(@Param("group") Group group, @Param("user") User user);
    
    List<Wallet> findAllByGroup(Group group);
}
```

**Locking Strategy:** ✓ VERIFIED - Pessimistic write lock prevents concurrent modifications.

## All Balance Modification Points

### Summary Table

| Operation | Service Method | Transaction | Locking | Amount |
|-----------|---------------|-------------|---------|--------|
| **Deposit/Withdraw** | `WalletService.deposit()` | @Transactional | PESSIMISTIC_WRITE | Any (+ or -) |
| **Propose Bet** | `BetService.propose()` | @Transactional | Via WalletService | -amountCents |
| **Accept Bet** | `BetService.accept()` | @Transactional | PESSIMISTIC_WRITE (bet) + Via WalletService | -acceptorStake |
| **Win Payout** | `SettlementService.settleGame()` | @Transactional | PESSIMISTIC_WRITE (bets) + Via WalletService | +poolCents |
| **Push Refund** | `SettlementService.settleGame()` | @Transactional | PESSIMISTIC_WRITE (bets) + Via WalletService | +originalStake |
| **Void Refund** | `SettlementService.settleGame()` | @Transactional | PESSIMISTIC_WRITE (bets) + Via WalletService | +originalStake |

**All modifications go through `WalletService.deposit()`**, which provides centralized validation and locking.

## Potential Bugs and Issues

### 1. CRITICAL: Missing Balance Check on Propose/Accept

**Location:** `BetService.propose()` line 98-100

**Issue:** The code has a commented-out balance check:

```java
// If your WalletService already blocks negative balances inside deposit(), you can omit this check.
// Otherwise uncomment the next line and implement getBalance/ensure in WalletService.
// walletService.ensureSufficientBalance(req.getGroupId(), req.getProposerId(), req.getAmountCents());
```

**Current Behavior:**
- `WalletService.deposit()` calculates `newBalance = currentBalance + amountCents`
- **If `amountCents` is negative** (debit), it checks `if (newBalance < 0) throw IllegalArgumentException("Insufficient funds")`
- This means the check happens **inside the transaction**, after acquiring the lock

**Problem:**
- If a user has 100 cents and tries to bet 200 cents, the transaction will **start**, acquire locks, then **rollback** due to insufficient funds
- This is inefficient but **functionally correct** - the transaction will fail before committing

**Recommendation:** ⚠️ Add an optimistic pre-check before starting the transaction to avoid unnecessary lock contention:

```java
// Pre-check (outside transaction, no lock)
Wallet wallet = walletRepo.findByGroupAndUser(group, user).orElse(new Wallet(group, user));
if (wallet.getBalanceCents() < req.getAmountCents()) {
    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Insufficient funds");
}

// Then proceed with transactional debit
```

**Severity:** Medium - Works correctly but inefficient under high load.

### 3. MEDIUM: Rounding in Acceptor Stake Calculation

**Location:** `BetService.calcAcceptorStake()` line 217-223

**Current Implementation:**
```java
private static long calcAcceptorStake(long proposerStake, double odds) {
    return BigDecimal.valueOf(proposerStake)
        .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(odds).subtract(BigDecimal.ONE))
        .setScale(0, RoundingMode.HALF_UP)
        .longValueExact();
}
```

**Issue:** `HALF_UP` rounding can lead to slight discrepancies in pool calculations.

**Example:**
- Proposer stakes 1000 cents at odds 1.37
- Acceptor stake = 1000 × 0.37 = 370 cents (exact)
- Pool = 1000 + 370 = 1370 cents

**But:**
- Proposer stakes 1001 cents at odds 1.37
- Acceptor stake = 1001 × 0.37 = 370.37 → rounds to 370 cents
- Pool = 1001 + 370 = 1371 cents
- House loses 0.37 cents

**Over millions of bets, this could accumulate.**

**Recommendation:** ⚠️ Consider whether the house or users should absorb rounding:
- **Option A:** Round up acceptor stake (users pay more, house gains)
- **Option B:** Round down acceptor stake (users pay less, house loses) - CURRENT
- **Option C:** Track rounding errors in a separate "house edge" account

**Severity:** Low for small volume, Medium for high volume.

---

### 4. LOW: Missing Transaction Isolation Level Configuration

**Location:** Application configuration

**Issue:** No explicit transaction isolation level set. Spring defaults to database default (usually READ_COMMITTED for PostgreSQL).

**Potential Race Condition:**
1. Thread A reads wallet balance: 100 cents
2. Thread B reads wallet balance: 100 cents
3. Thread A debits 80 cents → balance = 20 cents
4. Thread B debits 80 cents → balance = -60 cents (OVERDRAFT!)

**Current Mitigation:** ✓ VERIFIED - The `findByGroupAndUserForUpdate()` method uses `PESSIMISTIC_WRITE` lock, which **blocks** concurrent transactions from reading until the lock is released.

**Recommendation:** ✓ Already handled by pessimistic locking, but document this clearly.

**Severity:** Low - Already mitigated.

---

### 5. MEDIUM: Double Settlement Risk

**Location:** `SettlementService.settleGame()` line 56-115

**Issue:** While the method is idempotent (only settles `ACCEPTED` bets), there's no explicit guard against:
- Two admins clicking "settle" simultaneously
- Scheduled job + manual trigger overlapping

**Current Behavior:**
- Both calls acquire `PESSIMISTIC_WRITE` lock on bets
- First call settles bets, changes status to `RESOLVED`
- Second call sees `RESOLVED` status, skips those bets
- **Result:** No double-payment ✓

**Potential Issue:**
- If one call is processing bet A while another processes bet B (different games), they won't block each other
- This is **intentional** for parallelism but means no "settlement in progress" flag

**Recommendation:** ⚠️ Add audit logging to track:
- Who triggered settlement
- Timestamp
- Which bets were settled
- Any conflicts detected

**Severity:** Low - Already functionally safe due to status checks.

---

### 6. LOW: No Audit Trail for Balance Changes

**Location:** Wallet entity

**Issue:** No `WalletTransaction` table to track:
- When balance changed
- Why it changed (bet placed, bet won, deposit, etc.)
- Amount of change
- Previous/new balance

**Current State:** Balance is **write-only** - once changed, no history exists.

**Recommendation:** ⚠️ Create a `wallet_transactions` table:
```sql
CREATE TABLE wallet_transactions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    wallet_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES wallets(id),
    amount_cents BIGINT NOT NULL,
    previous_balance_cents BIGINT NOT NULL,
    new_balance_cents BIGINT NOT NULL,
    reason VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, -- 'BET_PLACED', 'BET_WON', 'DEPOSIT', 'REFUND'
    reference_id UUID, -- betId or transactionId
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);
```

**Benefits:**
- Debugging balance discrepancies
- User transaction history
- Compliance/auditing
- Detecting fraud

**Severity:** Medium - Important for production financial systems.

### 7. LOW: No Maximum Bet Limit

**Location:** `BetService.propose()`

**Issue:** No check for maximum bet amount. A user could theoretically:
- Deposit $1,000,000
- Place a bet for $1,000,000

**Recommendation:** ⚠️ Add configurable limits:
```java
private static final long MAX_BET_CENTS = 100_000_00; // $100,000

if (req.getAmountCents() > MAX_BET_CENTS) {
    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Bet exceeds maximum allowed");
}
```

**Severity:** Low - Depends on business requirements.

---

### 8. CRITICAL: Missing Database Constraint on Balance

**Location:** Wallet entity

**Issue:** No database-level constraint preventing negative balances.

**Current Protection:** Application-level check in `WalletService.deposit()`:
```java
if (newBalance < 0) {
    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Insufficient funds");
}
```

**Problem:** If a bug bypasses this check or direct SQL is used, negative balances are possible.

**Recommendation:** ✓ MUST ADD - Database constraint:
```sql
ALTER TABLE wallets ADD CONSTRAINT balance_non_negative 
CHECK (balance_cents >= 0);
```

**Severity:** HIGH - Defense in depth for financial data.

## Conclusion

The money flow logic is **architecturally sound** with proper use of:
- ✓ Escrow model (money locked on propose/accept, released on settlement)
- ✓ Pessimistic locking to prevent race conditions
- ✓ Transactional boundaries ensuring atomicity
- ✓ Integer arithmetic (cents) to avoid floating-point errors
- ✓ Idempotent settlement logic

**However**, the system needs additional **defensive layers** before production:
- Database constraints as a safety net
- Comprehensive concurrency tests
- Audit logging for compliance
- Pre-transaction validation for performance

**Overall Risk Level:** MEDIUM - Core logic is correct, but lacks defense-in-depth and observability for a financial system.

## Appendix: Full Transaction Flow Diagram

```
USER DEPOSITS
└─> POST /api/groups/{groupId}/wallets/deposit
    └─> WalletService.deposit() [@Transactional]
        └─> WalletRepo.findByGroupAndUserForUpdate() [PESSIMISTIC_WRITE]
        └─> wallet.setBalanceCents(current + amount)
        └─> WalletRepo.save(wallet)

USER PROPOSES BET
└─> POST /api/groups/{groupId}/bets
    └─> BetService.propose() [@Transactional]
        └─> WalletService.deposit(userId, -amountCents) [debit]
        └─> BetRepo.save(bet) [status=OPEN]

USER ACCEPTS BET
└─> POST /api/bets/{betId}/accept
    └─> BetService.accept() [@Transactional]
        └─> BetRepo.findByIdForUpdate(betId) [PESSIMISTIC_WRITE]
        └─> Check status == OPEN
        └─> WalletService.deposit(acceptorId, -acceptorStake) [debit]
        └─> bet.setStatus(ACCEPTED)
        └─> BetRepo.save(bet)

ADMIN SETTLES BETS
└─> POST /api/groups/{groupId}/bets/settle-accepted
    └─> SettlementService.settleAcceptedBetsForGroup() [@Transactional]
        └─> BetRepo.findByGameIdForUpdate(gameId) [PESSIMISTIC_WRITE]
        └─> For each bet in ACCEPTED status:
            ├─> If PROPOSER_WIN:
            │   └─> WalletService.deposit(proposerId, poolCents) [credit winner]
            ├─> If ACCEPTOR_WIN:
            │   └─> WalletService.deposit(acceptorId, poolCents) [credit winner]
            └─> If PUSH:
                ├─> WalletService.deposit(proposerId, proposerStake) [refund]
                └─> WalletService.deposit(acceptorId, acceptorStake) [refund]
```
